import os
import requests

def extract_text(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    headers = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': config.get('api_key', 'YOUR_API_KEY')
    }
    url = 'https://<region>.cognitiveservices.azure.com/text/analytics/v3.2/ocr'
    data = {
        'language': 'auto',
        'detectOrientation': True,
        'includeTextOrientation': True
    }
    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={'data': payload}, params=data)
    result = response.json()
    return result['text']
